messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. Person 2 says: "I'll keep to my left." (Person 2 is facing you: their left is your right, and their right is your left.) Which way do you move, left or right?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Right
Because Person 2 keeps to their left, which is your right, so you keep to your right to avoid them.
